items.text:
I really liked this game at first. But as I got more into it, the flaws became so big that they took away from my enjoyment. Looting ships and building up your own around the starting zone is very fun and detailed and the difficulty curve provides some great satisfaction when you finally get a handle on things. At first.

But as soon as I started using the torch drive to travel to other systems, I kept running into obnoxious bugs and problems that there was no explanation for. I'd spend hours trying to think up solutions and researching what little data there is for the game only to run into more problems. Some players frame this as "the game doesn't hold your hand" but come on. I'm spending so much time researching and testing things that, honestly, should just work out of the box. At some points hiding mechanics goes beyond the 'benign frustration' mode into the realm of punishment. I'm sad to say that this game passes that point. 

They have a discord but they need a wiki. I wish they had some way of contacting them outside of Discord such as a website or email address. I just got tired of making exceptions for the game -- I've never played a game where I had to go into debug mode and cull NPCs to prevent it from stuttering every few seconds. 

Needs improvement but has tremendous potential.
items.text_zh:
一开始我真的很喜欢这款游戏。但随着我玩得越来越深入，那些缺陷变得如此之大，以至于夺走了我的乐趣。在起始区域附近掠夺船只并建造自己的船非常有趣且细节丰富，当你终于掌握窍门时，难度曲线会带来极大的满足感。一开始是这样。

但当我开始使用火炬驱动器前往其他星系时，我不断遇到令人恼火的bug和问题，而且没有任何解释。我会花几个小时试图想出解决方案，并研究游戏中那少得可怜的数据，结果却遇到更多问题。有些玩家把这说成是“游戏不会手把手教你”，但得了吧。我花了那么多时间研究和测试那些老实说本该开箱即用的东西。在某些时候，隐藏机制已经超出了“无害的挫败感”模式，进入了惩罚的领域。我很遗憾地说，这款游戏越过了那条线。

他们有Discord，但他们需要一个wiki。我希望他们能有Discord之外的某种联系方式，比如网站或电子邮件地址。我只是厌倦了为这款游戏破例——我从未玩过一款游戏，需要我进入调试模式并剔除NPC以防止它每隔几秒就卡顿。

需要改进，但潜力巨大。
